meta.name: do
meta.description: Execute a phased implementation plan using subagents. Use when asked to execute, run, or carry out a plan — especially one created by make-plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用子智能体自动执行分阶段计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果已有分步计划需要自动执行
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a step-by-step plan to execute automatically

howto.what: Claude会充当总指挥，把计划拆成多个阶段，每个阶段派出专门的子代理干活，自己只负责协调和核验。每阶段结束会安排子代理做验证、查常见错误、审代码质量，全部通过后才提交改动。
howto.when: 当你要求执行、运行或实施某个计划时触发，尤其当该计划是make-plan生成的。

say.text: 请按这个计划分阶段执行。
say.note: Claude会派子代理逐阶段实施并验证。

say.text: 替我运行这个计划，每阶段完成后先验证再继续。
say.note: 验证通过前不会推进到下一阶段。

say.text: 按照计划执行，但代码质量问题要先审查。
say.note: 会部署代码质量子代理检查改动。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as an orchestrator: it breaks the plan into phases and deploys dedicated subagents to do the work, while it coordinates and checks results. After each phase it runs verification, anti-pattern, and code-quality reviews, and commits only after checks pass.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to execute, run, or carry out a plan, especially one created by make-plan.

say_en.text: Please execute this plan phase by phase.
say_en.note: Claude deploys subagents for each phase and verifies them.

say_en.text: Run this plan, verifying each phase before continuing.
say_en.note: It won't advance until verification passes.

say_en.text: Execute the plan but review code quality first.
say_en.note: A code-quality subagent checks the changes.
